newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK PAIRIS MAKES TRADING DEBUT WEDS.
newsitem.headline: GREEK PAIRIS MAKES TRADING DEBUT WEDS.

text.p: Shares of Greek plastics manufacturer Pairis will start trading on the bourse's parallel market tomorrow, the Athens stock exchange said in a statement.

The firm issued 410,160 new common registered shares at 1,150 drachmas a share and raised 471 million drachmas. Forty percent of the IPO proceeds will finance its investment programme and 60 percent will go towards its working capital needs.

ErgoBank was the lead underwriter. Alpha Credit Bank, Xiosbank, Alpha brokerage, N.D. Devletoglou Securities and Omega Securities were the co-underwriters. Alpha Finance was the issue advisor and Ergo Finance was the company advisor.
The eight percent daily volatility limit will not be applied in the first three days of trading following a decision by the capital markets commission.
